evidence_classes.legacy_internal_regression: Existing unit/self-check suite; protects behavior but may share production assumptions.
evidence_classes.direct_named_test_binding: Public engineering function is explicitly referenced by a packaged test; not independent correctness evidence.
evidence_classes.coverage_execution: Function body executed in packaged coverage run; not correctness evidence.
evidence_classes.independent_direct_function_oracle: Separately written expected arithmetic/closed-form value compared with production function.
evidence_classes.phase_0_23_route_oracle: Independent route-level arithmetic evidence inherited and rerun under v0.24.
evidence_classes.boundary_adversarial: Explicit branch/domain expected result or expected exception.
evidence_classes.analytical_mutation_probe: Sensitivity check against intentionally altered analytical relation; not AST/source mutation testing.

anti_overclaim_rule: Only independent direct function oracles and inherited independent route oracles are counted as independent numerical evidence.
